title: Billing, Payments and Entitlements
case_ids_frozen_by: P13 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P13-Txxx identifiers

capability_contract.scope: Close P13 billing/payment/entitlement lifecycle only; generic features JSON remains non-authoritative; inherit P06 domain authority and P12 Workspace/notification core; P17 admin-permission lifecycle and P19 public Website/SEO completion remain later-owned.

inherited_functional_authority.scope: Domain request/approval, ownership, DNS, HTTPS, risk, redirect and downgrade authority is inherited; P13 adds billing/quota contribution and must not duplicate or reinterpret the P06 domain safety namespace.

p13_implementation_api_authority: POST /api/payments/callbacks/{provider} — P13 implementation authority, not IA-exact
rules: Only GET /api/public/plans is IA-exact; remaining P13 API families are P13 implementation authority and must not be described as IA-exact.
Provider callback route is payment-subsystem authority, never generic APP-WEBHOOKS/user-configurable webhook authority.
No invented /app/billing/plans, /app/billing/usage or /app/billing/invoices page aliases; APP-BILLING is /app/billing.
WEB-PRICING data/API substrate may be implemented by P13, but P19 Website/SEO ownership remains later-owned.
Workspace billing is authenticated, server tenant/RBAC, noindex, no-store, outside sitemap; Admin commerce additionally requires billing.manage.
P13 consumes P15/P17 principal/permission boundaries but does not claim those lifecycle modules complete.
Provider slug must be in the frozen inventory; unknown providers fail closed.
Each adapter authenticates provider-specific callback signature/credential before any durable state mutation.
Authenticated callback is normalized to durable provider/transaction/event identity; replay and reordering are idempotent.
Raw callback body, signature, secret, token, credential, full payer identity and provider evidence are not logged or emitted in normal evidence.
Callback response reveals no internal entitlement/secret detail and is safe for provider retry semantics.
CI uses deterministic cryptographically valid provider fixtures/adapters; no live production credentials or real charges.
Browser return/success pages are never payment settlement authority; settlement comes from authenticated server callback or authoritative server-side provider verification.

entitlement_contract.authoritative_resolver: One server-side durable entitlement resolver; frontend/navigation/price cards/cache/features JSON are never authorization or entitlement authority.
source_order: hard security/workspace/admin suspension or explicit durable revoke denies
active durable manual/inherited grant with provenance
active billing-plan grant with provenance and term/grace boundaries
entitlement_contract.combination: For an entitled capability, active numeric grant limits combine by explicit non-additive maximum unless a capability-specific frozen rule says otherwise; billing expiration/refund removes only billing-source contribution.
entitlement_contract.domain_rule: Custom-domain use requires BOTH effective P13 domain entitlement/quota AND inherited P06 request/approval/ownership/DNS/HTTPS/risk authority; payment never bypasses P06 safety.
entitlement_contract.downgrade_rule: Downgrade/expiry may deny new over-limit mutations but must preserve existing resources unless the owning capability contract explicitly requires cleanup; no silent destructive downgrade.
rules: Every grant/revoke records source/provenance and effective time boundaries.
Manual/inherited grants survive unrelated billing refund/expiry unless explicitly revoked.
features JSON is display/supporting metadata only and MUST NOT be queried by the resolver.
Client optimistic payment state may update presentation only; it cannot activate entitlement.
All money is integer minor units plus ISO currency; never floating-point money.
Mutable admin records use optimistic concurrency/versioning.
Provider transaction/event identity is unique in provider scope.
Order idempotency stores a one-way hash of client idempotency material; raw secrets are not persisted.
Audit/callback metadata is allowlisted/redacted and cannot contain raw provider secrets or unnecessary PII.

workspace: owner: read and manage plan/order/invoice/payment Workspace billing
admin: read plan/usage/status summary but cannot change plan, create payable order or access sensitive provider details
member/viewer: no financial ledger or billing mutation; capability enforcement is exposed only as safe entitlement state/reason
rbac_contract.admin: Admin commerce mutation/read authority requires current principal with billing.manage; P13 consumes that permission and does not implement P17 permission lifecycle.
rules: All workspace financial reads/mutations resolve current P12 membership from MySQL and scope by Workspace.
Cross-workspace IDs fail closed without disclosing foreign financial existence.
Client/test role headers are never billing authorization authority.
Canonical desktop/tablet/mobile plus 320 CSS px reflow and reduced motion.
Keyboard/focus/error/status semantics are accessible; no color-only payment state.
Offline/partial/provider-failure states never present stale payment/FX facts as current success.
Workspace/Admin billing pages are noindex/no-store and do not enter sitemap.
WEB-PRICING may consume public safe plan data but P13 does not claim P19 final Website/SEO composition.

notification_contract.owner: P13 producer events only; P12 owns notification core.
rules: Producer is internal-only and uses P12 recipient+dedupe_key idempotency.
Deep links are registered/allowlisted and reauthorized by P12 core at read time.
Title/summary/context never expose provider secrets, full payment instrument, raw callback evidence or unnecessary PII.

environment_contract.providers: Deterministic authenticated provider adapters/fixtures in CI; no live production payment credentials or real charge.
environment_contract.p06: Reuse inherited P06 domain entitlement/safety/downgrade authority.
environment_contract.p12: Reuse P12 Workspace membership and notification core.
environment_contract.browser: Built Workspace/Admin surfaces with real local APIs; public plan substrate may be inspected without claiming P19 completion.

closure.predecessor_rule: Bind P12 signed source 9d49d5ebf0e697ae9cd6537c432c27a15edc60bd / integration 7f39da389052b08f145e69dac2a715b9d303294d / run 32663159008 / artifact 9499336765 / digest sha256:72ed65c48303654b589edce23e9118ecc963940a7400e27a0f174d7e8ea07c9a; do not rerun/reinterpret P12 revision-specific closure on P13 HEAD. P06 domain authority is inherited functionally and likewise not reinterpreted.
closure.scope_rule: P13 closes billing/payments/entitlements only; P06 domain safety remains inherited, P12 notification core remains inherited, P17 permission lifecycle and P19 Website/SEO remain later-owned.

cases.oracle: Public plan output is safe/read-only; structured entitlements are server data and generic features JSON never participates in entitlement decisions.

cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: billing.manage can create/update/archive plans with validation/versioning; stale writes conflict; archived plan is not newly purchasable.

cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Effective entitlement is resolved server-side from durable provenance; hard deny wins; active grant limits do not add implicitly; frontend metadata cannot grant access.

cases.oracle: Order creation is Workspace/plan/currency validated, has one durable identity, and retried client intent cannot create duplicate payable obligations.

cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Invoice/order/transaction relationships and money/currency fields are immutable where required; state transitions are monotonic and auditable.

cases.name: Provider baseline inventory and credential isolation
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Only frozen provider identifiers are accepted; secrets are server-side encrypted/configured and never returned through ordinary APIs, logs or artifacts.

cases.name: Authenticated payment callback fail-closed
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: POST callback authenticates provider-specific signature/credential before mutation; invalid/missing signature fails closed with no entitlement change.

cases.name: Callback replay and idempotency
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Authenticated duplicate/reordered provider callbacks are idempotent by provider event/transaction identity and cannot double-apply payment or entitlement.

cases.name: Successful paid lifecycle to entitlement
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Authenticated settled payment atomically activates billing-source entitlement/quota and records provenance; no client optimistic success grants access.

cases.name: Failed payment lifecycle
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Failed/pending provider state never fabricates paid entitlement; existing valid entitlement remains governed only by its frozen lifecycle/grace rules.

cases.name: Refund lifecycle and entitlement consequence
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Authenticated refund is idempotent, auditable, reverses only billing-source contribution according to policy, and never deletes unrelated manual/inherited grants.

cases.name: Currency and FX authority
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Stored monetary amounts keep currency; FX has source/as-of status, stale/provider-error semantics and audited override; stale FX cannot masquerade as current.

cases.name: Upgrade lifecycle
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Upgrade payment/order transition applies the new plan once authoritative payment conditions hold; quotas change deterministically without duplicate grant.

cases.name: Downgrade grace lifecycle
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Downgrade schedules a durable target/end/grace boundary; current grant persists only for the frozen grace interval and UI reports future effective state.

cases.name: Downgrade expiry and enforcement
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: At grace/term expiry the billing-source grant changes atomically; over-quota resources are preserved but new violating mutations are denied; P06 domain downgrade behavior remains coherent.

cases.name: P06 business-domain entitlement continuity
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Custom-domain capability requires both P13 effective quota/entitlement and inherited P06 approval/ownership/DNS/TLS/risk authority; neither side can bypass the other.

cases.name: Manual/inherited entitlement coexistence
cases.precondition: Real current-repository P13 authority and fixtures required by the case; no live production charge/credential.
cases.oracle: Durable manual/inherited grants keep provenance and survive unrelated billing expiry/refund; explicit hard revoke/suspension wins; active limits combine by frozen non-additive rule.

cases.name: Billing audit and secret/PII redaction

cases.oracle: Money-state/admin/callback mutations record actor/provider/resource/correlation/result without raw payload signatures, credentials, payment secrets or unnecessary PII.
